Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. - dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.

=== markdown_renderer.go ===
     1	package renderer
     2	
     3	import (
     4		"bytes"
     5		"fmt"
     6		"strings"
     7	
     8		gast "github.com/yuin/goldmark/ast"
     9		east "github.com/yuin/goldmark/extension/ast"
    10	
    11		mast "github.com/usememos/memos/internal/markdown/ast"
    12	)
    13	
    14	// MarkdownRenderer renders goldmark AST back to markdown text.
    15	type MarkdownRenderer struct {
    16		buf *bytes.Buffer
    17	}
    18	
    19	// NewMarkdownRenderer creates a new markdown renderer.
    20	func NewMarkdownRenderer() *MarkdownRenderer {
    21		return &MarkdownRenderer{
    22			buf: &bytes.Buffer{},
    23		}
    24	}
    25	
    26	// Render renders the AST node to markdown and returns the result.
    27	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) Render(node gast.Node, source []byte) string {
    28		r.buf.Reset()
    29		r.renderNode(node, source, 0)
    30		return r.buf.String()
    31	}
    32	
    33	// renderNode renders a single node and its children.
    34	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderNode(node gast.Node, source []byte, depth int) {
    35		switch n := node.(type) {
    36		case *gast.Document:
    37			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
    38	
    39		case *gast.Paragraph:
    40			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
    41			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
    42				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
    43			}
    44	
    45		case *gast.Text:
    46			// Text nodes store their content as segments in the source
    47			segment := n.Segment
    48			r.buf.Write(segment.Value(source))
    49			if n.SoftLineBreak() {
    50				r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
    51			} else if n.HardLineBreak() {
    52				r.buf.WriteString("  \n")
    53			}
    54	
    55		case *gast.CodeSpan:
    56			r.buf.WriteByte('`')
    57			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
    58			r.buf.WriteByte('`')
    59	
    60		case *gast.Emphasis:
    61			symbol := "*"
    62			if n.Level == 2 {
    63				symbol = "**"
    64			}
    65			r.buf.WriteString(symbol)
    66			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
    67			r.buf.WriteString(symbol)
    68	
    69		case *gast.Link:
    70			r.buf.WriteString("[")
    71			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
    72			r.buf.WriteString("](")
    73			r.buf.Write(n.Destination)
    74			if len(n.Title) > 0 {
    75				r.buf.WriteString(` "`)
    76				r.buf.Write(n.Title)
    77				r.buf.WriteString(`"`)
    78			}
    79			r.buf.WriteString(")")
    80	
    81		case *gast.AutoLink:
    82			url := n.URL(source)
    83			if n.AutoLinkType == gast.AutoLinkEmail {
    84				r.buf.WriteString("<")
    85				r.buf.Write(url)
    86				r.buf.WriteString(">")
    87			} else {
    88				r.buf.Write(url)
    89			}
    90	
    91		case *gast.Image:
    92			r.buf.WriteString("![")
    93			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
    94			r.buf.WriteString("](")
    95			r.buf.Write(n.Destination)
    96			if len(n.Title) > 0 {
    97				r.buf.WriteString(` "`)
    98				r.buf.Write(n.Title)
    99				r.buf.WriteString(`"`)
   100			}

package v1

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"connectrpc.com/connect"
	"github.com/grpc-ecosystem/grpc-gateway/v2/runtime"
	"github.com/labstack/echo/v5"
	"golang.org/x/sync/semaphore"

	"github.com/usememos/memos/internal/markdown"
	"github.com/usememos/memos/internal/profile"
	v1pb "github.com/usememos/memos/proto/gen/api/v1"
	"github.com/usememos/memos/server/auth"
	"github.com/usememos/memos/server/notification"
	"github.com/usememos/memos/store"
)

const maxAPIRequestBytes = 256 << 20

type APIV1Service struct {
	v1pb.UnimplementedInstanceServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedAuthServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedUserServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedMemoServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedAttachmentServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedAIServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedShortcutServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedIdentityProviderServiceServer

	Secret                  string
	Profile                 *profile.Profile
	Store                   *store.Store
	MarkdownService         markdown.Service
	SSEHub                  *SSEHub
	NotificationEmailSender notification.EmailSender

	// thumbnailSemaphore limits concurrent thumbnail generation to prevent memory exhaustion
	thumbnailSemaphore       *semaphore.Weighted
	imageProcessingSemaphore *semaphore.Weighted

	// instanceStatsCache memoizes GetInstanceStats results for instanceStatsCacheTTL.
	instanceStatsCache instanceStatsCache
}

func NewAPIV1Service(secret string, profile *profile.Profile, store *store.Store) *APIV1Service {
	markdownService := markdown.NewService(
		markdown.WithTagExtension(),
		markdown.WithMentionExtension(),
	)
	return &APIV1Service{
		Secret:                   secret,
		Profile:                  profile,
		Store:                    store,
		MarkdownService:          markdownService,
		SSEHub:                   NewSSEHub(),
		NotificationEmailSender:  nil,
		thumbnailSemaphore:       semaphore.NewWeighted(3), // Limit to 3 concurrent thumbnail generations
		imageProcessingSemaphore: semaphore.NewWeighted(2),
	}
}

// RegisterGateway registers the gRPC-Gateway and Connect handlers with the given Echo instance.
func (s *APIV1Service) RegisterGateway(ctx context.Context, echoServer *echo.Echo) error {
	// Shared authorizer: one source of truth for authentication and anonymous-access
	// policy, used by both the gRPC-Gateway middleware and the Connect interceptor.
	authorizer := NewAuthorizer(s.Store, s.Secret, s.Profile)
